notes: June 5–10, 1967. Preemptive strikes, all four territories captured in six days. Confirmed.

title: Reunification of Jerusalem
notes: East Jerusalem captured from Jordan June 7, 1967. Western Wall under Jewish control. UN rejected annexation. Confirmed.

title: Entebbe Hostage Rescue
